title: Canopy
description: Looking straight up from the forest floor into a full autumn canopy. The trees reach out in every direction and the light breaks through the centre. It feels like standing in the middle of something enormous and completely still.

title: Plumage
description: A peacock reimagined in bold geometric shapes and pure colour. The feathers fan out in spirals of orange, teal and gold. It is still very much a bird but it feels like something closer to a celebration.

title: Still Waters
description: A lone chapel tower sits at the edge of a mountain lake, its reflection perfectly mirrored in the calm water. Everything is still. It is one of those scenes that makes you want to just stop and look for a while.

title: Crimson
description: One deep red rose against a soft wash of lime and gold. Three dewdrops sit on the petals, catching the light. Simple subject, but something about it just holds your attention.

title: Deep Blue
description: An orca moving through layers of ocean blue, from bright turquoise near the surface down to near-black at the bottom. There is something about painting these animals that never gets old.

title: Daisy Days
description: A black and white calf peeks out from a field of white daisies, its wide eyes full of gentle curiosity. Cheerful, warm and impossible not to smile at.

title: Little One
description: A little tabby kitten sitting with its paws tucked, looking straight at you. Painted small and quick with a lot of warmth. One of those pieces that people always stop at.

title: Jack
description: A pumpkin with a very unsettling grin, bloodshot green eyes and a bat sitting on top like it owns the place. It is spooky but mostly it just makes people laugh. Good Halloween energy.

title: The Raven
description: A raven painted up close, black feathers picking up blues and greys against a sky that goes from deep orange to bright gold. That one white fleck in the eye is what makes the whole thing come alive.

title: Glide
description: A sea turtle moves upward through clear blue water, its intricate shell and lace-like flippers rendered in careful detail. Peaceful, unhurried, entirely in its element.

title: Blood Moon Voyage I
description: A tall ship coming straight at you as a huge blood moon rises behind the masts. The sky is all orange and red. It started as a study in scale and ended up being one of my favourites.

title: Serpent
description: A green snake's face painted very close up, the scales breaking into something that looks almost like stained glass. The eyes are gold and amber and a little unnerving. Exactly what I was going for.

title: Blood Moon Voyage II
description: The same tall ship painted again, this time with a deeper sky of purples and blues. The mood is heavier, the sea a bit rougher. I painted this one right after the first and could not stop.

title: Harbourside
description: A seagull standing on a post, puffed up and unbothered. The sea is soft behind it. There is something funny and dignified about it at the same time.

title: Little Robin
description: A robin perched on a bare branch against a pale winter sky. The orange chest is the only warm thing in the painting and that felt right.

title: Sanctuary
description: A log cabin tucked into an autumn forest with a waterfall spilling over rocks in front of it. The kind of place you imagine and never quite find.

title: Road to Rainier
description: The road to Mt. Rainier cutting through dense Pacific Northwest pines. The canopy closes in on both sides and the light ahead pulls you forward. A place that feels bigger than wherever you came from.

title: Sovereign
description: A bald eagle in close portrait against a dark background. The yellow eye catches the light. Not a bird you look away from quickly.

title: Ginkgo
description: Ginkgo leaves layered over each other in green, yellow and gold. The shapes are bold and almost geometric. I kept going back to add more and eventually made myself stop.

title: Tropical
description: Three large banana leaves reach upward against a flat turquoise sky. Bold, clean shapes and very satisfying to paint.

title: Summer Canopy
description: The same upward view through the trees but in summer. Everything is green and the light comes through softer. A companion to Canopy painted in a different season.

title: The Cockerel
description: A rooster in close portrait against a black background, all red comb and sharp eye. There is a lot of personality in a small canvas.

title: Plumeria
description: Six white and yellow plumeria flowers scattered across a dark background with gold leaf detail. Each flower took a long time. It was worth it.
